paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi'n Pathian thu angaihkhiak ua, amah aboh huthut lai un, amah Gennesaret tuipi gei ah adingh hi.
heading: Jesu Nungzui Masate Sapna / (Mat 4.18-22; Mar 1.16-20)
english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

paite: Huan tuipi gei a long nih om amu a, himahleh ngaman mite apawtkhia ua, alente uh asawp uhi.
english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

paite: Huchi in long khat Simon a pen ah atuang a, akiang ah lui gei a kipan neukha tolhlutsak deuh angen hi. Huan atu a, long a kipan mipite thu ahilh hi.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

paite: Huan thugen azoh in, Simon kiang ah, "Lithuk lam naih unla, ngaman ding in, na lente uh pai un," achi hi.
english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

paite: Huan Simon in akiang ah, "Heutupa, gimtak in zankhua in ka pang ua, bangmah ka man kei ua, himahleh na thu in lente ka pai nawn ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

paite: Huan apaih ualeh nga tampitak akhuh ua, alente uh akek iak-iak hi.
english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

paite: Huan long dang a om alawmte uh amau huh ding in akhutvan hial uhi. Ahong pai ua, long nih tum phialphial in asungdim tuaktuak uhi.
english: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

paite: Simon Peter in huai amuh in, Jesu khebul a bokkhup in, “Toupa, hon paisan in, mikhial ka hi,” achi hi.
english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

paite: Anga mat uh amah leh alawmte'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi;
english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

paite: Simon pawlte mah Zebedai tapa Jakob leh Johan in leng lamdang asa mahmah sam uhi. Simon kiang ah Jesu'n, "Lau ke'n, tuban siah mihing na manta ding," achi hi.
english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

paite: Huan lui gei ah alongte uh atolh galkai ua, bangkim paisan in amah azuita uhi.
english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khua khat a a-om lai in ngai dih, mi khat phak a pumdim a-om a, ama'n Jesu amuh in, ama a bokkhup in, "Toupa, na utleh na hon hihsiang thei," chi in angen ngutngut hi.
heading: Phak Hihdamna / (Mat 8.1-4; Mar 1.40-45)
english: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

paite: Ama'n sawk in akhoih a, "Ka ut hi, na siangta in,” achi hi. Huan thakhat in aphak ahong bei pah hi.
english: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

paite: Akiang ah, "Kuamah hilh ke'n, himahleh siampu kiang ah va ki-ensak inla, na sianthouna ding Mosi seh bang lan in, mite theihchetna ding in," achi hi.
english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

paite: Himahleh atanchin thu athang semsem a; mipi tampitak athu za nuam leh anatnate uh hihdam ut in ahong kikhawm kheukhou uhi.
english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

paite: Himahleh amah gamdai ah apaituam a, athum hi.
english: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in ni khat thu ahilh hi. Akiang ah Pharisaite leh dansiamte atu uhi, huaite Galili leh Judia gam kho teng a kipan a hong pai ahi uhi. Mite hihdamna ding in akiang ah Toupa thilhihtheihna a-om hi.
heading: Mizaw Hihdamna / (Mat 9.1-5; Mar 2.1-12)
english: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

paite: Huan ngai dih, lupna toh mizaw khat ahon zawng ua; ama a koih ding in zawnlut atum uhi.
english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

paite: Himahleh mipi ziak in zawnlutdan ding amu thei kei ua, intung a kipan alaitak, Jesu ma ah alupna toh akhaikhesuk uhi.
english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

paite: Huan aginna uh amuh in akiang ah, "Mihing, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
english: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

paite: Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n, "Pathian gensia hiai mi kua ahia? Pathian kia lou in kua'n ahia khelhnate ngaidam thei?" chi in angaihtuah uhi.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n angaihtuah uh athei a, akiang uah, "Na lungtang uah bang na ngaihtuah ua?
english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

paite: Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita, chih leh thou inla, khe in paita in, chih, akoi pen gen anuam zaw?
english: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

paite: Himahleh, khovel ah Mihing Tapa in khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," damlou mizaw kiang ah, “Thou inla, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in, ka hon chi,” achi hi.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

paite: Huchi in amitmuh un athou pah a, alupna ala a, Pathian phat kawmkawm in a-inn ah apaita hi.
english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

paite: Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, Pathian aphat uhi. "Tuni in thillamdang pitak i mu hi,” achi ua, alau mahmah uhi.
english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

paite: Huaite khit in apawt a, siah piakna mun a tu, siahkhonmi khat amin Levi amu a; akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
heading: Levi Sapna / (Mat 9.9-13; Mar 2.13-17)
english: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

paite: Huchi in adingh a bangkim paisan in azuita hi.
english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

paite: Huan Levi in a-inn ah Jesu a ding in ankuang thupitak alui a; siahkhonmi leh midangte toh mi tampi in amau a-umpih chiat uhi.
english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

paite: Pharisaite leh laigelhmite anungzuite tung ah aphun uhi, "Bangziak a siahkhon mite leh mikhialte kiang a ne a dawn na hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Midam-theite'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamtheiloute'n akiphamoh uhi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

paite: Midiktatte sam ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte kisiksak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," chi in adawng hi.
english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Johan nungzuite'n an angawl zel ua, athum zel uh; Pharisaite nungzuite'n leng huchibang mah in ahih zel uh; himahleh na nungzuite'n ane un adawn gige uh," achi uhi.
heading: An Ngawl Thu A Dotna / (Mat 9.14-17; Mar 2.18-22)
english: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Moupi mite kiang a apasal ding a om lai siah moupi mite an angawlsak thei ua hia?
english: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

paite: Himahleh apasal ding amau a kipan pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai ni chiang in zaw angawl ding uh," achi hi.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

paite: Huan akiang uah gentehna thu leng agen a, "Kuamah in puan thak them in puan lui athuap ngei kei, thuap mah le uh, athak in akaikek dia, athak them leh alui akituak kei ding uhi.
english: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

paite: Huan kuamah in uain thak savun uain thawl lui ah athun ngei kei, thun le uh uain thak savun thawlte apuakzak dia, abo dia, savun thawlte leng asegawp ding uhi.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

paite: Uain thak savun uain thawl thak ah athun zaw ding uhi.
english: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

paite: Huan kuapeuh uain lui na dawn khin in leng, athak aduh pah kei hi; alui pen hoihzaw achi ngal a,” achi hi.
english: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
